title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: How do you prefer to communicate with friends?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢怎样和朋友交流？

sentences.en: I prefer talking face to face.
Please pay attention to what I say.
Drop me a line when you arrive.
I will show you around the school right away.
It is polite to listen carefully.
Let's make up and move on.
Most important of all, just be yourself.
